name: Domain Keeper
desc:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it is a guardian who watches over the Pillar Hall of the heavens.
Though entrusted with "eyes" as a guardian of the Pillar Hall of Space, these entities can do nothing but extol the "Ideal Forms" of the noumenal world. With no way to behold the complexities of the phenomenal world, they are thus not counted among the kindred of angels. Whether this inherent contradiction is a product of their creator's rational design, or if the master they serve ultimately failed to grasp the intent of that primordial being, is a truth that remains beyond our reach.

dropMaterial.name: Mora
dropMaterial.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

dropMaterial.name: Faded Flaming Hilt
dropMaterial.desc:
The hilt remains of a flaming sword once wielded by a Domain Keeper.
A sword of blazing fire was once the symbol of protection. Empowered by the authority of "Space," it sealed the boundary between eternity and ephemera.

dropMaterial.name: Fractured Flaming Hilt
dropMaterial.desc:
The hilt remains of a flaming sword once wielded by a Domain Keeper.
A sword of blazing fire was once the symbol of judgment. Empowered by the authority of "Space," it barred the path against trespass and profanity.

dropMaterial.name: Jeweled Flaming Hilt
dropMaterial.desc:
The hilt remains of a flaming sword once wielded by a Domain Keeper.
A sword of blazing fire was once the symbol of admonition. Empowered by the authority of "Space," it proclaimed the absolute and infallible will of the divine.

customize.text: A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it can monitor and counter elemental attacks. In combat, the Domain Keeper will enter the Deluded Eye state. While in this state, the Domain Keeper will <color=#ffe04b>track the number of Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo DMG instances it takes, respectively</color> . When it has taken <color=#ffe04b>3</color> instances of DMG from any of these elements, the Domain Keeper will exit this state and transform into the corresponding elemental form, applying that element to itself and <color=#ffe04b>gaining a RES increase in the corresponding element</color> .
